reason: I run everything from my phone, Excel and WhatsApp and I don't trust software with my customers. Nobody outside their own company pays for this yet, so I'd be the guinea pig, and I'm not paying $99 a month for that.
objection: Nobody else is using it. If it answers my customers wrong or books a job badly, I lose the customer, not them. And it's one more subscription on top of what I already have.
would_change_my_mind: A few other one-truck guys like me, in my trade, who've been using it for months and will tell me it works. Or a cheaper plan, around $40 to $50, with a free trial that only answers missed calls and texts and doesn't touch my schedule.
